newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Ciampi sees improved deficit data in July.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Ciampi sees improved deficit data in July.

text.p: Italy's state deficit should show further signs of improvement in July after a strong showing in the first half of the year, Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi told parliament on Wednesday.
Ciampi said data from the first half indicated that the deficit would be less than half that seen in the same period last year.
"The forecasts that one can make for July...(suggest) there will be a further improvement," he added.
The government has pledged to cut the deficit to 3.0 percent of gross domestic product this year from 6.7 percent in 1996.
